race.comment: Wide-open maiden. SAISOKU (2) just missed at the mile two back then kept coming late over the 1600m again latest. First try at the trip but is drawn for a soft run and expected to be tough to hold out. FOREVER VICTORIOUS (8) tackled the same race last time and was runner-up after racing close to the speed. Also having her first try at this journey and has a tricky gate but expected to push forward and give a sight. HE'SNOTALLTHERE (4) turned in a good effort when narrowly defeated last time at Pinjarra over 2013m. Overdue for a win and is a leading hope. MYSTACHEENO (5) showed early speed from an outside draw and held a forward position before fading to finish fifth, beaten 1.2 lengths, last start over 1675m at this track. At top and worth keeping safe. CHIEF COMMANDER (10) is sure to be thereabouts.
